name: BLT-MCP
description: Provides AI agents with structured access to the OWASP Bug Logging Tool (BLT) ecosystem for logging bugs, triaging issues, and managing security workflows. It enables actions like submitting vulnerabilities, tracking contributor leaderboards, and awarding gamified bacon points through a unified interface.
